spans.s: SV0150 मधित madhita Is prepared by churning the curd and removing butter, without adding water. Alleviates Kapha and Pitta.
AF1183 मधु इच्छा madhu icchā Fond of Honey
AF1184 मधु इव मूत्रं madhu iva mūtraṁ Urine resembles honey in color and appearance
DG0158 मधु वर्ग madhu varga Class of different sources of Honey
SV0152 मधुक्रोडा madhukroḍā Prepared with flour mixed up with honey and solidified by frying.
DG0159 मधुर madhura Sweet; one among six rasa.
SK0118 मधुर madhura Sweet, something that is sweet to taste
DG0161 मधुर त्रय madhura traya Class of following 3 substances having Madhura Rasa viz. Sharkara, Madhu & Ghrita.
DG0162 मधुर त्रिफला madhura triphalā Class of following three fruits having madhura rasa; viz. Gaṁbhārī (Gmelina arborea), khajūr(Phoenix sylvestris), Draksha(Vitis vinifera).
AF1185 मधुर रसता madhura rasatā Sweet taste
DG0160 मधुर स्कन्ध madhura skandha Class of substances having actions attributed to Madhura Rasa.
AF1187 मधुरभक्षण द्वेष madhurabhakṣaṇa dveṣa Aversion to sweet food
AF1186 मधुरास्यता madhurāsyatā Sweet taste
BK0093 मधुशुक्त madhuśukta The fermented liquid using the honey on attaining acidity
AF1188 मधुसमं madhusamaṁ Urine resembles honey in color and appearance
SV0151 मधूच्छिष्ट वस्त्र madhūcchiṣṭa vastra Clothes anarnked with wax (bee). Decreases vata Doṣa. Gives strength, improves appetite & pitta Doṣa.
DG0163 मध्य वीर्य madhya vīrya Moderate Potency;
AF1189 मध्यभङ्ग अस्थि madhyabhaṅga asthi Fracture in the middle of the bone

SK0119 मध्यम कोष्ठ madhyama koṣṭha A physiological type of Koṣṭha produced because of the dominance of either Kapha, or due to the balanced state of all the three Doṣas. The individual with this type of Koṣṭha, passes normal bowels and has normal digestive ability.

DG0164 मध्यम पन्चमूल madhyama pancamūla Combination of following five plants; Bala(Sida cordifolia), Punarnava(Boerhāvia diffusa), Eranda(Ricinus communis), Mudagparni(Phaseolus trilobus), Mashparni(Teramnus labialis).

SV0155 मध्यम सत्व madhyama satva Medium psyche- sustains them at the instance of other or entirely by others. These persons are able to with stand grief, fear, anger, confusion and conceit to some extent.
BK0094 मध्यमपाक madhyamapāka Completing the process in optimal stage
AT0196 मध्यमवीर्य लूता madhyamavīrya lūtā Moderately venomous spiders with fatal period between 7 to 15 days.

SV0154 मध्यम् वय madhyam vaya Middle age- from 16- 60 years .It is characterized by strength virility, quality of all dhātus having reached the normal limits with proper physical & mental strength, without degeneration in qualities of dhātus with predominance of pitta dhātu.
SV0153 मध्याह्नः madhyāhnaḥ Midday:
SV0156 मध्येभक्त madhyebhakta Medicine consumed in between the meal cure diseases bestows strength and alleviates diseases of head and neck
